title: Ordinal-safe filter pushdown through duplicate labels
hypothesis: A repair to a small physical-plan optimizer can require preserving positional column identity through alias reversal and predicate remapping when displayed labels repeat.
why_hard: Output ordinal, display label, source expression, and predicate scope are distinct. A label-only lookup can redirect a filter onto the wrong side of a left join while leaving the plan superficially plausible.
next_action: Build original plan fixtures and compare ordered rows before and after optimization; include nested and reordered projections, duplicate labels, computed expressions, and a control that requires safe pushdown.

sources.note: Recorded issue reproducer for incorrect predicate binding through duplicate projection labels; current upstream status has not been rechecked for this catalog.

notes: Runtime fallback behind fixed-binary validity. Public behavior must state that labels may repeat and predicates bind to ordinals. A safe-pushdown audit prevents disabling the optimizer from satisfying the task. No completed model trial is documented.
